pure-announcement.rationale: Not framed as a launch or funding announcement — just an extremely minimal project description with no promotional framing.

duplicate.rationale: No existing concept overlaps with terminal/session-sharing tools; nearest neighbours (CycloneDX object model, gateway channel ownership, retry escalation ladder) are unrelated.

unfalsifiable.rationale: What little is stated (tmux fork, BSD license) is trivially true and checkable — the problem is that there is no substantive claim here at all, not that a claim is unverifiable.

durability.rationale: The two facts given (tmux fork, BSD license) will still be true in twelve months, but the note carries essentially no substantive content — closer to a name-drop than a described mechanism or trade-off.

actionability.rationale: There is nothing to act on: no mechanism, no design choice, no security claim, no guidance — the GitHub landing page's extractable text was only a two-line description and a license note, missing the write-access-equals-execution point the kernel was chasing entirely.

atomicity.rationale: Trivially: the entire note is already under one sentence, so whatever thin idea it carries is stated in far less than one paragraph.
